title: workflow.changed payload
description: Emitted by BMS when the channel's CATALOG of workflows changes — a version published, a workflow activated, deactivated or archived (EP-22.11). The catalog (`GET /workflows/catalog`) is every ACTIVE workflow with its published definition, which every authenticated user's client keeps a copy of; this event is broadcast to all of them so each refetches what changed (an ETag'd catalog read, or the one version) and drops what left. Saving a draft does not emit it: drafts are not in anyone's copy.

change.description: What happened. A client branches on it: published/activated → (re)fetch; deactivated/archived → drop from the copy.

state.description: The workflow's state after the change. Only `active` is in the catalog.

latestVersion.description: The newest published version — the one the catalog carries.

revision.description: The workflow's revision after the change; a client holding an older one is stale.
